tldr: For the fully displayed triangular robust objective, the all-procedure local minimax scaled regret over independent binary trials with unknown controls and public interior assignment probabilities converges to \(V_\gamma((4/3)I_2)\). A moving-baseline full-record lower bound and one total data-only attaining rule give the same constant. Rational outward box-program certificates converge to that exact variational value. The four essential actions have rank-two score noise, nonadditive scores, and two triple vertices. The known-control \(I_2/2\) benchmark retains the certified plug-in versus \(4/5\) calibration margin exceeding \(0.00107016\); this is no enlarged-class shrinkage dominance or scarcity claim. The actual least-favorable effect support remains unresolved, but its two-point envelope and the gap to the full value are computable, and equal opposite-sign priors are excluded. Chen--Guggenberger is the verified unrestricted rank-three comparator. The four-independent-coordinate Gaussian calculation is conditional algebra; Masten supplies only attested author-abstract metadata. The attributed correspondence with Shen et al., Proposition 3.1, Equation (7), remains externally unverifiable because the primary equation is inaccessible.
gap: The source robust objective defines allocation from trial summaries. Its repeated-trial regret with unknown control risks requires a lower bound against every full-record rule and a matching uniform data-only implementation. The audited scalar, asymmetric, covariate, validity, matched-design, independent-treatment, shrinkage, and finite-game results do not calculate the sharp value of this constrained robust loss.
fill: The contribution target is \(M_n^{\mathrm{rand}},M_n^{\mathrm{det}}\to V_*\), using finite-prior full-record likelihood lower bounds and an everywhere-defined rule with covariance homogenization and data-derived randomization. Outward certificates determine the same constant to arbitrary tolerance. Explicit representation obstructions make the comparison to existing treatment-choice solutions auditable. Within the audited named literature, this is the first such characterization for the specified unknown-control RO-SATE objective; the priority claim is confined to that objective and audit.
